flowchart TD subgraph ADVERTISING_PHASE["Phase 1: Periodic Advertising (Asynchronous)"] A1["Sleep (Radio OFF) ~98ms"] --> A2["TX on CH 37 (2402 MHz)"] A2 --> A3["T_IFS (150 μs)"] A3 --> A4["TX on CH 38 (2426 MHz)"] A4 --> A5["T_IFS (150 μs)"] A5 --> A6["TX on CH 39 (2480 MHz)"] A6 --> A1 end
subgraph CONNECTION_PHASE["Phase 2: Connected Events (Synchronous FHSS)"] C1["Connection Anchor (t = 0ms)"] --> C2["Central Packet TX (Data CH n)"] C2 --> C3["T_IFS (150 μs)"] C3 --> C4["Peripheral Packet RX & Reply"] C4 --> C5["Sleep until next Connection Event (t = 20ms)"] C5 --> C1 end
